scope: Staging, admission, and output bounds for specialized IMAGEDEF and IMAGEDEF_REACTOR DXF output.

behavior: IMAGEDEF plans refuse selected-reactor, common-reactor, or preserved-reactor collections above dwgSafety::MaxReactorCount (1,000,000).
writeObjects validates caller-owned IMAGEDEF collections before opening its OBJECTS output transaction.

The regenerated IMAGEDEF reactor list uses DRW::reserve, enforces the aggregate emitted-reference limit, and uses a second exception-catching reservation for duplicate detection while retaining source order for output.
The selected source-reactor lookup catches allocation exceptions and fails through the existing output rollback path.
writeImageRecord refuses another generated IMAGEDEF_REACTOR once the preserved-reactor bound is reached.

focused.coverage: ASCII/Binary IMAGEDEF records with 1,000,001 common reactor references refuse without publishing output.
The broader selector fails during TABLES emission with an unclosed FIELDLIST profile, before writeObjects emits IMAGEDEF/IMAGEDEF_REACTOR records; this slice does not resolve that profile.

limitations: The 1,000,000 limit is the existing internal reactor resource ceiling, not an Autodesk format maximum or support claim.
Allocation-failure injection, unrelated OBJECTS assembly collections, and other copy/work bounds remain open.
The rooted IMAGEDEF graph cohort remains failing at an earlier TABLES/FIELDLIST gate and requires separate diagnosis.
next: Continue the bounded safety audit on remaining output staging paths; keep the rooted IMAGEDEF graph failure separate until its TABLES/FIELDLIST blocker is diagnosed.
